meta.title: USB Slideshow & Signage - USB photo, video, and music player for Roku
meta.description: USB Slideshow & Signage is a Roku app for playing photos, videos, and optional background music from a USB drive. Start a full-screen slideshow or signage loop, browse media in Gallery, adjust slide interval, shuffle playback, choose image display settings, and unlock larger USB media collections with a Roku subscription.

items.a: USB Slideshow & Signage is a Roku app for playing photos, videos, and optional music from a USB drive as a full-screen slideshow or digital signage loop.

items.q: How do I start a slideshow?
items.a: Add playable media to a USB drive, connect it to your Roku device, open the app, and choose Start Slideshow from the Home Menu.
Yes. The app can scan folders and subfolders for images, videos, and audio files.

items.q: Can videos play in the slideshow?
items.a: Yes. Images and videos can play together in a continuous visual loop. Videos advance when playback finishes.
Yes. You can select one USB audio file as optional background music for image slides, or turn background music off.

items.q: Why does music stop during videos?
items.a: Background music is released while videos play so the video's own audio can be heard.
Gallery is a TV-friendly USB media browser where you can open folders and launch playback from selected images or videos.
Not always. File recognition is based on extensions, but actual playback depends on Roku codec, container, device, and file support.

items.q: Does the app upload my media?
items.a: No. The app is designed for local USB media playback and is not designed to upload your media library to a Service Provider cloud account.
A Roku subscription unlocks fuller access to larger USB media collections beyond the free access limits.

items.a: It is a Roku app for playing USB photos, videos, and optional music as a full-screen slideshow or signage loop.

items.q: Do I need internet for local USB playback?
items.a: Local USB playback does not require a Service Provider media server. Internet may still be needed for Roku subscriptions, Help/FAQ, legal pages, support, and feedback links.
The app recognizes many common image, video, and audio extensions. Actual playback depends on Roku platform codec, container, device, and file support.
Yes. The Home Menu includes fixed slide interval options such as 3, 5, 7, 10, 12, 15, and 20 seconds.
Yes. Shuffle Slides can be toggled from the Home Menu and applies to Home Menu Start Slideshow visual order.

items.q: Does the app support digital signage?
items.a: Yes. It is designed for simple USB-based slideshow and signage loops. Test your media before public display and keep backup copies of important files.
No. The current app focuses on USB browsing and slideshow/signage playback. It does not provide time/date scheduling or cloud playlist management.

items.q: Where can I manage subscription information?
items.a: The app includes Subscribe and Manage Subscription options. Purchases, renewals, and entitlement recovery are handled through Roku.
